notes: Scholars and mages: a crystal ball, wand and mage's sign for the core; the rares are the Moonglow Orrery, the town's stone fountain, a moongate display, a scholar's nook and Scholars' Row, the row of hanging shop signs. The Orrery is era grade C (no dated record of the art) but it is the town's one-of-a-kind landmark and would be missed.

entries.why: Crystal ball for the seer's table
Moonglow Orrery, 11x11 brass telescope on a runed dais (grade C, see notes)
Blue moongate display, the town's namesake
Scholar's nook with desk, lamp and shelf, 2x2
Scholars' Row, 4x1 hanging signs of the Lycaeum quarter
